intent.raw: Refine a research and prototype plan for an open canvas of Research Towers where every selectable level is an evidence-bound scene.
intent.objective: Produce a non-executed, source-bound multi-tower canvas plan for CyberAlchemy Lab and the existing IDE workbench.
intent.operator_sentence: Create a plan for an open tower canvas that grows from the one synthetic witness without pretending that design-stage Tower System components exist.

route_menu.context_hint: The selected route is a source-bound research and prototype plan, not implementation or engine selection.

items.label: Evidence-scene plan
items.description: Plan a read-only multi-tower canvas from the current synthetic witness.

items.label: External engine study
items.description: Only if a named local gap blocks the plan; requires a new operator confirmation.

technique_overlays.trigger: A visual scene may be mistaken for an asserted runtime capability.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Every planned scene declares evidence sources, state, claim ceiling, unavailable state, and refusal behavior.

technique_overlays.trigger: Spatial navigation and motion can hide semantic or accessibility failures.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The work pack contains keyboard, reduced-motion, narrow-viewport, and unavailable-level acceptance checks.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The plan combines separate semantic and interaction/accessibility lenses over more than three source surfaces; sequential independent review protects the parent context and prevents visual overclaim.
subagent_strategy.explanation: The semantic mapper owns only source-to-scene boundaries. The critic consumes that receipt and attacks spatial interaction and accessibility. The parent alone writes the Refine artifacts and makes no product mutation.
context: no external research without a named gap and operator confirmation

roles.purpose: Map current fixture and taxonomy evidence into permitted scene content.
Challenge navigation, motion, accessibility, and responsive behavior without expanding scope.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: The operator confirmed the two local read-only reviewer roles as part of this Refine strategy.

steps.name: Context Builder baseline
stop_conditions: stop if source evidence cannot distinguish the two layer vocabularies

steps.name: Invoke Define
stop_conditions: stop if the definition implies a real corpus or authority

steps.name: Interrogation refine review
convergence_criteria: retain only source-bound, testable scene requirements
stop_conditions: stop if an interaction requirement needs unknown external evidence

steps.name: Research decision
stop_conditions: ask the operator before any new external research

steps.name: Distill selected vertical slice
stop_conditions: stop if a scene cannot name its evidence and refusal state

steps.name: Invoke Design
stop_conditions: stop if design requires an unapproved dependency or a new external source

steps.name: Interrogation design review
convergence_criteria: resolve only defects that are testable in the future work pack
stop_conditions: stop if the design hides unproven states

steps.name: Distill repair
stop_conditions: stop if negative controls cannot be stated

steps.name: Invoke Plan
stop_conditions: stop before product mutation or Goal ledger application

steps.name: Refine synthesis
stop_conditions: stop when the next route needs a separate user confirmation

gates.condition: The semantic mapper receipt names exact sources, preserves both layer vocabularies, and makes no authority claim.
Any named gap requiring new external research must receive a new explicit confirmation.
This Refine run writes only run-local artifacts and the dispatch ledger; product code and fixtures remain untouched.

agents.residue: representative selection and blocked promotion remain open

validation: source selectors and evidence-state separation returned
native_stage_receipts.handoff_note: Use only as a source-bound scene contract input.

validation: interaction, accessibility, mobile, and refusal constraints returned
native_stage_receipts.handoff_note: Use only to constrain the later work pack.

promotion_guardrails: Do not promote inventory, ontology, glossary, skill, spell, source fixture, or product claim from this planning result.
A later Goal may stage a fresh Lab-specific Craft context but must not consume the active IDE Workbench UI context.

boundaries.contract: Reviewers return receipts only; they may not mutate source or product paths.
External research is blocked until a named gap and a new confirmation exist.
